title: Payments API returning 502s after release v4.11.0
alert: HTTP 5xx rate on payments-api > 25% for 5m. Logs: 'HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms.'
root_cause: Release v4.11.0 added a synchronous fraud-score lookup inside the DB transaction, holding each connection ~4x longer. HikariCP pool (max 10) was exhausted under normal evening load.
fix: Rolled back to v4.10.3, then moved the fraud-score call outside the transaction and raised maximumPoolSize from 10 to 30.
failed_attempts: Restarting payments-api pods (errors came back within 6 minutes)
Scaling payments-api from 6 to 12 replicas (made it worse: Postgres hit max_connections)

title: All mobile clients failing TLS handshake on api.shopnest.in
alert: Synthetic check 'mobile-login' failing from all regions. Error: 'x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid'.
root_cause: The wildcard certificate for *.shopnest.in expired. cert-manager renewal had been failing silently for 3 weeks because the DNS-01 solver's Cloudflare API token was revoked during an access cleanup.
fix: Issued a new Cloudflare API token, updated the cert-manager secret, forced renewal with 'cmctl renew', and reloaded the ingress controller.
failed_attempts: Restarting the ingress controller (still served the expired cert)

title: Users logged out mid-checkout, carts emptied
alert: Spike in 'session_not_found' errors on checkout-web (3,400/min). Redis evicted_keys climbing rapidly.
root_cause: Redis session cluster hit maxmemory (4GB) because a marketing campaign cached full product payloads in the same Redis without TTLs. allkeys-lru policy evicted user sessions.
fix: Flushed the campaign cache keyspace, set a 15m TTL on campaign keys, and moved campaign caching to a separate Redis instance.
failed_attempts: Increasing checkout-web replicas (did nothing; the problem was in Redis)

title: Order confirmations delayed by 40+ minutes
alert: Kafka consumer group 'orders-confirmation' lag > 120,000 on topic orders.created. Consumer logs: 'JsonMappingException: Cannot deserialize value of type BigDecimal from String "N/A"'.
root_cause: A partner integration published an order event with price "N/A". The consumer crashed on the poison message, restarted, re-read the same offset, and crashed again in a loop, blocking the whole partition.
fix: Skipped the poison offset with kafka-consumer-groups --reset-offsets --shift-by 1 on partition 7, then deployed a dead-letter-queue handler for deserialization errors.
failed_attempts: Adding more consumer instances (the stuck partition can only be read by one consumer)
Restarting the consumer group (crashed again on the same message)

title: Search pods crash-looping with OOMKilled
alert: search-service pods restarting, reason OOMKilled. p99 latency 9.2s. Container memory limit 2Gi.
root_cause: Product catalog grew 35% after onboarding 3 new sellers. The in-memory synonym + facet index exceeded the 2Gi container limit.
fix: Raised memory limit to 4Gi and set JVM -Xmx to 3g (75% of limit). Filed a ticket to move facets to Elasticsearch aggregations.
failed_attempts: Rolling restart (pods OOMKilled again after index warm-up)

title: OTP SMS not delivered to customers
alert: notifications-worker error rate 60%. Upstream response: 'HTTP 429 Too Many Requests' from SMS provider (Kaleyra).
root_cause: A retry bug sent each failed SMS up to 10 times with no backoff, pushing us past the provider's 100 req/s rate limit during a sale.
fix: Hot-patched retries to exponential backoff with jitter (max 3 attempts) and enabled the secondary provider (Gupshup) for overflow.
failed_attempts: Restarting the worker (the retry storm resumed immediately)

title: Payment failures after deploy v4.14.0
alert: payments-api 5xx at 31%. 'HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms'. Postgres active connections at 30/30 per pod.
root_cause: v4.14.0 introduced a new refund-eligibility query without an index on refunds(order_id). Slow queries held connections for 8-12s and exhausted the pool.
fix: Rolled back to v4.13.2 (errors cleared in 3 min), then added index idx_refunds_order_id CONCURRENTLY and redeployed.
failed_attempts: Raising maximumPoolSize to 50 (Postgres CPU hit 95%, did not help)

title: All users getting 401 Unauthorized after login
alert: auth-service: 'JWT signature verification failed: kid=2026-05 not found in JWKS'. Login success rate 3%.
root_cause: Scheduled signing-key rotation published the new key, but the JWKS endpoint cache on downstream services had a 24h TTL, so they rejected tokens signed with the new key.
fix: Reverted token signing to the previous key id, purged JWKS caches across services, and changed rotation to publish new keys 48h before using them.
failed_attempts: Restarting auth-service (it kept signing with the new key)

title: Inventory writes failing: disk full on primary Postgres
alert: inventory-db primary: 'PANIC: could not write to file pg_wal/xlogtemp: No space left on device'. Disk usage 100%.
root_cause: A logical replication slot for a decommissioned analytics pipeline was never dropped, so Postgres retained 480GB of WAL.
fix: Dropped the inactive replication slot (pg_drop_replication_slot('analytics_slot')), WAL was recycled, and disk dropped to 41%. Added an alert on replication slot lag.
failed_attempts: Deleting old log files in /var/log (freed only 2GB)

title: Carts lost during flash sale
alert: checkout-web 'session_not_found' errors at 2,100/min. Redis used_memory 3.98GB / 4GB, evicted_keys rising.
root_cause: Same pattern as INC-1012: a new recommendations widget cached large payloads in the session Redis with no TTL.
fix: Deleted the rec:* keys, added a 10m TTL, and pointed the widget at the dedicated cache Redis. Added a lint rule requiring TTLs on Redis writes.

title: Orders stuck in PENDING, consumer lag growing
alert: Consumer group 'orders-confirmation' lag 48,000 on orders.created partition 3. 'JsonParseException: Unexpected character'.
root_cause: Malformed event from a legacy POS integration (truncated JSON). The DLQ handler from INC-1017 did not cover JsonParseException, only JsonMappingException.
fix: Extended the DLQ handler to catch all deserialization exceptions and skipped offset 1882201 on partition 3.

title: UPI payments timing out after release v4.16.1
alert: payments-api 5xx 22%. 'Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms'. Deploy v4.16.1 went out 18 minutes earlier.
root_cause: v4.16.1 wrapped the UPI callback handler in @Transactional and called the NPCI status API (p95 2.5s) inside the transaction, exhausting the connection pool.
fix: Rolled back to v4.16.0 immediately (resolved in 4 min). Fixed by moving the external call outside the transaction boundary.

title: Prices showing as 0 on product pages
alert: Customer support spike: 'price shows Rs 0'. catalog-service returning price=0 for 18% of SKUs.
root_cause: Feature flag 'new-pricing-engine' was enabled at 100% instead of 10%. The new engine returned 0 for SKUs without a regional price.
fix: Set the flag back to 0% in LaunchDarkly (fixed in 2 min), then invalidated the CDN cache for product pages.
failed_attempts: Rolling back catalog-service deploy (no deploy had happened; wasted 15 min)

title: Intermittent 'no such host' errors across services
alert: Multiple services logging 'dial tcp: lookup orders-service.prod.svc.cluster.local: no such host'. Error rate 8% cluster-wide.
root_cause: CoreDNS was scaled down to 1 replica by a Helm values change during a node pool upgrade. It was CPU-throttled and dropped queries.
fix: Scaled CoreDNS back to 4 replicas, removed its CPU limit, and enabled NodeLocal DNSCache.

title: Order emails and SMS failing during Independence Day sale
alert: notifications-worker: 'HTTP 429 Too Many Requests' from Kaleyra. Queue depth 220,000.
root_cause: Sale traffic was 6x normal. Even with backoff, sustained volume exceeded the primary provider's contract limit.
fix: Enabled overflow routing to Gupshup (the playbook from INC-1026) and throttled marketing notifications to protect transactional ones.

title: Search latency spikes and OOMKilled restarts
alert: search-service pods OOMKilled 14 times in 1h. Memory limit 4Gi.
root_cause: A new 'recently viewed' boost feature loaded per-user history into the JVM heap without eviction (unbounded HashMap).
fix: Disabled the boost via feature flag, then replaced the HashMap with a Caffeine cache (max 50k entries, 10m expiry).
failed_attempts: Raising memory limit to 6Gi (only delayed the crash)

title: Partner API calls failing TLS verification
alert: Partner webhooks failing: 'certificate has expired' for partners.shopnest.in.
root_cause: partners.shopnest.in used a manually uploaded certificate outside cert-manager, missed during the INC-1009 cleanup.
fix: Moved partners.shopnest.in to cert-manager, issued a new cert, and added a Blackbox exporter alert for certs expiring within 14 days.

title: Inventory DB disk at 94% and rising
alert: inventory-db primary disk usage 94%, growing 2%/hour. pg_replication_slots shows 'debezium_slot' inactive.
root_cause: The Debezium CDC connector crashed on Kafka Connect, leaving its replication slot inactive and WAL piling up. Same mechanism as INC-1038.
fix: Restarted the Debezium connector, so the slot became active and WAL was consumed. Added max_slot_wal_keep_size = 50GB as a safety limit.
